svg.title: Tensegra — crystallization across latent microsteps
svg.desc: A continuous field of latent tensor components rises into a typed symbolic workspace, forms a faceted dependency graph, progresses through exact computation, then returns as curved strands to the latent field. A microstep axis continues beneath all phases. This is a conceptual interface diagram.
svg.text: From continuous possibility to exact work, and back.
Projection · local commitment · protected execution · typed return
MANY RECURRENT MICROSTEPS / ONE CONTINUING LATENT WORKSPACE
Continuous state → typed proposal → protected symbolic transition → encoded return
